summary: The filing is a prospectus supplement (424B5) updating an existing at-the-market (ATM) equity offering program. CTO Realty Growth, Inc. added Cantor Fitzgerald and Huntington Securities as sales agents/forward sellers/purchasers, and amended its existing distribution agreements. As of the filing date, $57.3M of the $250M shelf had been sold, leaving ~$192.7M available. The filing is a routine shelf takedown update — not a special situation. No change of control, tender offer, activist, or strategic event is disclosed. This is a standard equity distribution update.
